comparisons.peer_topic: Real Estate Exposure and Criticized Assets Changes
comparisons.peer_summary: Real Estate exposure was $207.1 billion as of December 31, 2024. Criticized exposure increased by $3.2 billion to $12.4 billion, driven by downgrades primarily in Multifamily and Office.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and JPM report increases in criticized real estate exposure driven by similar sectors. BAC attributes a $1.4 billion (16%) increase in reservable criticized exposure primarily to industrial/warehouse and multi-family rental loans. JPM reports a $3.2 billion increase in criticized real estate exposure, predominantly driven by downgrades in Multifamily and Office. Both identify Multi-family as a key driver of increased credit risk trends in their commercial real estate portfolios.
